quests.title: Windblume Research Report

dialogue.t: What a romantic tradition. Now this is worth researching!
Oh, it's you, Traveler. Have you come to the library due to your interest in Mondstadt's romantic songs as well?
Still, words on a page can be read any time, but the history that happens all around us will slip by in but an instant.
The people of Mondstadt have many special rituals during this cozy, romantic time known as the Windblume Festival.
What form do these traditions take, and what of the history behind them? These are both most promising research angles.
I'm currently writing a research report, and I believe that descriptions alone will not suffice. Could you help me take some pictures of the sights around the Windblume Festival?
Thanks for helping with my research. I will certainly cite you in my acknowledgments.

All of the following deserve to be recorded: <color=#00E1FFFF>the floral decorations in the fountain plaza</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>the Anemo Archon statue adorned with flowers in front of the Cathedral</color>, and the <color=#00E1FFFF>flower shop owner, hard at work</color>.
Please help me take pictures of these sights, and pass those photos to me afterward.
Perhaps I should call my paper the "Windblume Festival Report"... No, no, that's far too boring...
Welcome to Floral Whisper. Do you need anything?
Hmm, I suppose it's true that the Windblume Festival is unique to Mondstadt. The people of Sumeru probably don't celebrate it.
He wants to take a photo of me and my flowers? Sure. Mr. Sayid really has a unique way of thinking. I suppose that's researchers for you, hehe.
Welcome to Floral Whisper. We're always very busy during the Windblume Festival.
Have you finished taking those pictures?
Oh, these are very well shot. I'm sure that they'll come in handy in my research.
Seeing such lovely sights reminds me of the festivals in my hometown, Sumeru...
Ah, I suppose you're not familiar with our traditions. Every year, we celebrate the Sabzeruz Festival to commemorate the birth of Lesser Lord Kusanali.
But if we want to compare the atmosphere, I'd say that there's some difference between the festivities now and the ones back home...
Speaking of which, I wasn't able to take part in this year's Sabzeruz Festival either. It's been so long — I wonder how things are at the Akademiya nowadays...
Well, I'm getting off-topic. Regardless, thank you for your help. Please accept these as payment.

quests.description: The ever-studious researcher, Sayid from Sumeru, has become intrigued by the Windblume Festival.
